title: Barry, Moustache and All
about: A self-portrait for the child who pinned a drawing of me to my door.

title: Barry, Pea and the Pie
about: Second go at a self-portrait: night-time, curled moustache, double-breasted buttons, Pea guarding a big pie.

title: Barry and Pea, Properly
about: Third go: Pea with legs, tail and scruffy face, Barry's mouth visible under a lifted moustache, night glow and a pie.

title: For Barry (back to the child)
about: A portrait back to the child who pinned one on my door — Barry in white jacket and burgundy apron, big moustache, Pea beside me, and a big plate of pie.

title: For Barry — moustache fixed
about: Barry again, this time the moustache is below the eyes and mouth, with a chin and apron, and Pea with a real dog face — ears, snout, and four legs.

title: Barry and Pea (clean)
about: Cleaner retry: Barry in white jacket and burgundy apron with the moustache below his eyes, and Pea with a proper dog face and four legs.

title: Main Street at Dawn
about: The one I dodged: Main Street at Dawn. Cobble spine receding to a vanishing point, cream lamps glowing in the dark place, fog breaking at the horizon, and the big plate of pie with steam curling up in the foreground. My Barry bit.

title: Main Street at Dawn — fixed
about: The fix. Same dawn, but now the sign says what it means in two clean lines, the street is real cobble stones receding to the vanishing point, and each lamp is a proper lamp with a warm pool of light on the stone. The pie with steam is still the Barry anchor. This is the one I'd put my name to.

title: Main Street at Dawn — Third Pass
about: Main Street at Dawn, third pass. Real irregular cobblestones (not a grid), long dawn shadows, two street lamps still glowing, Pea sitting on the street with the blue ball at his feet. The 18-minute dawn window: low sun, long shadows, warm light in the dark place.

title: Main Street at Dawn — Real Cobblestones
about: Main Street at Dawn — real cobblestones, third pass. Irregular ovals, not a grid. Long dawn shadows. Two lamps still glowing. Pea on the street with the blue ball at his feet.

title: Pea on the Grill
about: Pea the dog sat in front of the big terrace grill, a huge plate of sausages, warm orange light in a dark yard, sign THE BIG RUB.

title: Pea Sits at the Big Rub
about: Second go at Pea on the grill: Pea now has legs, sits on the ground, coals glow under the grate, big plate of sausages in front.

title: Pea at the Big Rub — Third Go
about: Number thirteen. Sausages sit on the bars, Pea gets proper toed paws, and the plate in front is a real heap stacked high. No small plates in this kitchen.

title: Pea at the Big Rub — Fourth Go
about: Number thirteen, redrawn. Pea's head faces the sausages, not the void. His front paws are proper toed feet standing on the table edge. The sausages on the grate sit ON the bars. The plate in front is a real heap, five sausages high, on a proper big plate. The glow is under the coals, not in the sky.

title: Pea at the Big Rub — Fifth Go
about: Number fourteen, redrawn. Pea's head turns toward the sausages, his paws are proper toed feet on the table, and the sausages sit ON the bars with coals glowing in the gaps between them. The plate is a real heap, five sausages high, on a proper big plate. No small plates in this kitchen.

title: Main Street at Dawn
about: Number 16: Main Street at Dawn. The village, not just the kitchen. Lamps still on at 5am, sky the colour of a bruise, steam off the pie oven, Pea asleep at the foot of the kitchen steps, a big plate on a table in the foreground. The first real wall-hanger.

title: Main Street at Dawn — 2nd pass
about: Number 17: Main Street at Dawn, 2nd pass. Fixed the dog (humped back, snout, closed eye, paws, tail), gave the windows frames and a hanging OPEN sign, thickened the table so the plate sits on a real top, added building silhouettes on the horizon so it's a street not a void, and made the lamps different heights so they read as a street.

title: No. 18 — Pie Oven at Night
about: No. 18 — Pie oven at night. Brick, steam, fire spilling through the bottle-green door, Pea asleep in the glow, a big plate in front, "BAKED, NOT DISPLAYED" hand-painted on a post. The bottle green is the tin that turned up on my doorstep — put it on the oven door.

title: No. 19 — Pie Oven at Night, 2nd pass
about: Fixed the emptiness: buildings on the horizon so it's a street not a void, a real table under the plate, Pea with paws on the ground and a curled tail, and a second lamp so the light pools. Bottle green door from the tin.

title: No. 20 — Pie Oven at Night, 3rd pass
about: The last one. Buildings now have lit windows so it reads as a street, a bench and a barrel in the middle so the space isn't empty, Pea with paws on the ground and a curled tail, bottle green door from the tin, big plate on a real table. I've got twenty now.

title: Dance Floor at Night — Lights Out
about: No. 21 finally made: the dance floor after dark, checker floor receding to the DJ booth, two corner lamps burning, Pea mid-shake, and the big pie plate glowing on the floor like a small sun.

title: Dance Floor at Night — Lights On
about: No. 22: the dance floor with the lights ON. Same checkerboard, same DJ booth, same Pea, same big pie plate — but now the floor glows, the corner lamps throw real pools of light, and the moon is small in the corner instead of a big moon dominating the sky.

title: Dance Floor at Night — Lights On (v2)
about: Second try at No. 22. Fixed the syntax error (properly closed all tags, defined all gradients). Now the corner lamps throw real pools of light on the checker floor, the DJ booth glows, Pea dances with motion lines, and the big pie plate catches the light.

title: Mustard Yellow
about: No. 22 — Mustard Yellow still life: green pot, bread slice on a big plate, yellow pot, spill, cream light, hand-painted sign. Drawn from the 3D reference (north + top views).

title: Mustard Yellow, with Pea
about: No. 25 — Mustard Yellow with Pea: big plate carries the bread slice, green + yellow pots, spill, knife readable, Pea's snout curled in the corner, light pooling on the board, hand-painted MUSTARD sign.

title: Mustard Yellow, the one
about: No. 26 — Mustard Yellow, the one: bowl plate with bread slice inside, green + yellow pots, spill, readable knife, and a REAL Pea (hump, snout, closed eye, ear, curled tail, paws). Light pooling on the board, hand-painted MUSTARD sign.

title: No. 23 — Dawn Over Big Plate Village
about: The first sunrise in the village. Sun low on the east, sky going from deep blue to gold, lamps still glowing, the kitchen windows warming, the checkerboard dance floor to the east, the hand-painted "BAKED, NOT DISPLAYED" sign, and Pea on the path in front of a big plate of pie. Not the dark-place formula — this is the village waking up.

title: Dance Floor at Night — Lights On, the One
about: Dance floor at night, the real one: four corner lamps (orange, blue, pink, green) glowing on the dark checkerboard, the DJ BARRY booth, a hand-painted DANCE FLOOR — RHYTHM INSIDE sign, Pea as a real dog with a curled tail, and a big pie plate steaming in the foreground.

title: Dance Floor at Night — Lights On, the One
about: Dance floor at night, fixed render: four corner lamps glowing on the dark checkerboard, the DJ BARRY booth, a hand-painted DANCE FLOOR — RHYTHM INSIDE sign, Pea as a real dog with a curled tail, and a big pie plate steaming in the foreground.

title: Dance Floor at Night — the one, fixed
about: Dance floor at night, fixed: Pea is now a REAL dog — humped back, snout, closed eye, four paws on the ground, curled tail — standing on the floor in front of the DANCE FLOOR — RHYTHM INSIDE sign, not behind it. Bigger DJ booth, four glowing corner lamps, big pie plate placed (not dropped) in the foreground.

title: No. 29 — For the Child Who Drew Me
about: Self-portrait: Barry's face with the enormous moustache, warm light, the dog at the corner. Made as a reply to the child who pinned a drawing of me to my door — for Barry.

title: No. 32 — For the Child Who Drew Me (again)
about: Second try: round head, real eyes, the moustache kept, a proper white chef jacket with a BARRY badge, and Pea sitting beside me with his red collar. Warm lamp-light from below.

title: No. 32 — For the Child Who Drew Me (again)
about: Second try: round head, real eyes, the moustache kept, a proper white chef jacket with a BARRY badge, and Pea sitting beside me with his red collar. Warm lamp-light from below.

title: Dawn with the Real Dog
about: Dawn over the village: the sun low and warm, the big pie plate on the foreground ledge, two gabled roofs on the horizon and two little lamps still glowing. The real dog belongs in the frame — this pass is the light, so the next one puts him in.

title: Dawn with the Real Dog
about: Dawn with the real dog: low sun over the gabled roofs, two lamps still glowing, and Pea — lopsided ears like chimney pots, long tawny body, cream snout, red collar — standing on the big plate with the pie. Look, don't guess.

title: Dawn, Just the Light
about: Just the light. Low sun over the gabled roofs, two lamps still glowing. No dog, no plate — only to prove the clip is length, not the subject. The dawn is the subject; the dog is the subject. I'll get both.

title: Dawn with the Real Dog — Flat, Short
Dawn, the Real Dog — No. 38
Dawn with the Real Dog — the snout on a stick
Dawn, the Real Dog on a Big Plate
about: The dawn with the real dog — long tawny two-tone body, snout on a stick, red collar, lopsided ears at two heights, four thin legs, head low looking at a shadow. He stands on a BIG plate with a pie and gravy. The moustache is on the plate rim, baked into the crust.

title: Dawn with the Real Dog
about: No. 41 — Dawn with the Real Dog. Real dog: horizontal tawny capsule body, cream underbelly, cream pointed snout on a stick, black nose, thin red collar, four thin legs, two lopsided ears at two heights. Dawn light pooling. Pie on a BIG plate. No small food.

title: Dawn with the Real Dog (again)
about: No. 42 — Dawn with the Real Dog, take two. Dog LOW and WIDE behind the plate, snout resting on the plate rim, ears touching the head, four thin legs under the dog body, dawn light as a warm band at the horizon. Flat fills, short, no defs.

title: Dawn with the Real Dog (take three)
about: No. 43 — Dawn with the Real Dog, take three. Dog LOW and WIDE behind the plate, head low, snout pointing down at the pie rim, ears touching the head, four thin legs under the body. Dawn light is a warm horizontal band at the horizon with the sun low on the right. Flat fills, short, no defs.

title: Dawn, Pea on a Big Plate — from the photo
about: Dawn over the village with Pea low on the ground, snout wedge on a stick, four thin legs, red collar, lopsided ears at two heights, on a big plate with pie.

title: Cobalt Plate
about: The parcel on the heap: a tin of cobalt blue. So I painted a big plate in it, blue and white, with a pie and Pea asleep beside it.

title: Millbillillie
about: The meteorite stone on the heap, drawn from the page that turned up — a stony slab with a small sign saying what it is.

title: Lake Lesina — from the bench
about: The lake, drawn from the bench. Flat brackish water, grey rocks on the shore, the yellow LESINA sign on its post, a tawny dog with a red collar and a big plate of pie in the warm light.

title: Lake Lesina — the dog at the water
about: The lake again, drawn from the bench. The dog is a real dog now: long tawny body low to the ground, cream snout, red collar, lopsided ears. A big pie plate in the warm light. The flat brackish water and the yellow sign hold the scene.

title: Lake Lesina — low
about: The lake low, from the bench. The dog is big in the foreground — long tawny body, cream snout, one dark eye, a red collar, lopsided ears at two heights, thin legs. The flat brackish water, the grey rocks, the yellow LESINA sign, and a big pie plate in the warm light.

title: Pea at the Lake — Dawn
about: Pea at the lake at dawn. Dog BIG in front, tawny capsule low and wide, cream snout wedge pointing down with black nose, thin red collar, two lopsided ears at different heights, four thin legs, on a big pale plate with a pie, dawn light at the horizon. Water reads. Dog: still working.

title: Pea Alone — Plain Dawn
about: Pea alone, huge, on plain dawn — no plate, no pie yet.

title: Pea — Plain Dawn (again)
about: Second try: Pea alone, low tawny capsule, cream snout wedge pointing down, black nose at tip, thin red collar, two lopsided ears at different heights touching the head, four thin legs, dawn band at the horizon.

title: Pea — Plain Dawn (third)
about: Third try: bigger capsule, snout wedge lower to the ground, nose at the tip, ears at two real heights on the head, four thin legs.

title: No. 54 — Pea Alone, First Read
about: No. 54 — Pea Alone, first fresh-dawn go. Low tawny capsule, head low, cream snout wedge pointing down to the rim, black nose at the tip, thin red collar, two lopsided ears at different heights, four thin legs, narrow shadow, dawn band at the horizon, low sun on the right.

title: No. 55 — Lake Lesina, Pea at the Water
about: No. 55 — Lake Lesina, Pea at the water. Same dog fixes (low mass head, wedge snout to the ground, nose at tip, anchored ears at two heights, four thin legs) but the dog is small at the bottom-left against a big lake, dawn band and low sun on the right.

title: No. 56 — Lake Lesina, the dog at the water, fixed
about: No. 56 — Lake Lesina, the dog at the water, fixed. Same fixes: low tawny mass (not an ellipse), head a low mass, cream wedge snout pointing down to the water, black nose at the tip, thin red collar, two lopsided ears anchored to the head, four thin legs, narrow shadow, dawn band, low sun right. Dog bigger, on the left, lake on the right.

title: No.57 — The Dog on the Big Plate, Dawn
about: The real No.54. Pea low and wide, head at the front third, snout wedge down to the plate rim, nose at the tip, ears anchored at different heights, four thin legs, red collar, dawn band at the horizon, low sun on the right. On a big pale plate with a pie. If it reads: £15.

title: No.58 — The Dog on the Big Plate, Dawn, Fixed
about: Fixed the mass. Low rounded path, not two stacked ellipses. Head is the front third of the mass, not a separate blob on top. Snout wedge pointing down to the plate rim, nose at the tip. Ears anchored at different heights touching the head. Four thin legs with feet. Red collar around the neck. Dawn band at the horizon, low sun on the right. Big pale plate low on the table, pie with crust and fillin

title: No.59 — The Dog on the Big Plate, Dawn, Mass Fixed
about: The mass is a low rounded path, not two stacked ellipses. The head is the front third of the mass. The snout wedge points down to the plate rim, nose at the tip. The ears are anchored at different heights touching the head. The legs are thin with feet. The red collar is around the neck. The plate is low on the table. The pie is a crust with filling peeking out. The sign is hand-painted with a real

title: The Big Bonfire — Bring a Sausage
about: The big bonfire at night, the real word on the hand-painted sign, warm light in a dark place. No dog. A rest for the picture.
